title: Add learning paths and capability status guide
description: Add docs pages for persona-based learning paths and capability status matrix under the guides category.
action: Modify inventory.ts to add doc page ids 'learning-paths' and 'capability-status' in category 'guides'. Extend content-guides.ts with entries containing headings '写作者路径', '开发者路径', '集成者路径', '维护者路径', and status labels 'supported', 'partial', 'experimental', 'historical', 'roadmap'.

convergence.definition_of_done: Readers can choose a persona learning path and inspect capability maturity status.

files.change: Add learning path and status matrix entries.
Link to learning paths from homepage.

implementation: Add learning-paths page in inventory.ts under guides category with title '学习路径'.
Add capability-status page in inventory.ts under guides category with title '能力状态矩阵'.
In content-guides.ts, add learning-paths content with four persona paths: writer, developer, integrator, maintainer, each with 4-6 linked steps.
In content-guides.ts, add capability-status content defining supported, partial, experimental, historical, roadmap and a table covering docs-site categories.
Update LandingPage quickLinks or featuredDocs to include '/guides/learning-paths'.

rationale.chosen_approach: Guides pages centralize orientation and capability maturity without bloating every category page.
rationale.tradeoffs: Requires maintaining status labels as capabilities evolve.

risks: Capability status can drift if not aligned with CAPABILITY_MATRIX.
